data.name: AlFalah
data.gender_notes: AlFalah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: AlFalah is derived from the Arabic root ‘Falaha’, which means ‘to succeed or prosper’. In Islamic context, AlFalah is often used to refer to the concept of divine guidance and success in the afterlife. The name also symbolizes wisdom and righteousness. The name AlFalah carries the meaning “Success, Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlFalah usually hope their child will grow to embody success, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah's blessings and mercy
data.etymology: AlFalah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Success, Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlFalah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
